title: Full function over 9.0-16.0 V supply range
procedure: Set ambient 23 °C, controller normalized. Set supply to 9.0 V, then 16.0 V; also test 8.9 V is not required here (see TC-002). At each voltage, perform manual open/close, express open/close, anti-pinch trigger, and read WLC_Status. Repeat at 9.1 V and 15.9 V (just inside limits).
pass_criteria: Manual, express, anti-pinch and CAN functions at 9.0 V and 16.0 V: full function at supply voltages from 9.0 V to 16.0 V

title: Low-voltage behavior 6.0-9.0 V: manual only
procedure: Controller normalized, 23 °C. Set supply to 8.9 V, 7.5 V and 6.1 V. At each voltage, short-press (<300 ms) the switch in close and open directions. Hold the switch and confirm manual movement. Set supply to 9.0 V and confirm express works again (boundary).
pass_criteria: Express mode between 6.0 V and 9.0 V: disabled; Manual mode between 6.0 V and 9.0 V: operates (manual mode only)

title: Motor stop on undervoltage below 6.0 V
procedure: Run the motor in manual mode at 13.5 V. Step supply from 13.5 V to 5.9 V; capture motor drive and supply with a scope; measure time from crossing 6.0 V to motor stop. Repeat stepping to 6.1 V (just above) and confirm the motor is not stopped by this function. Repeat at 23 °C, three runs.
pass_criteria: Time from supply below 6.0 V to motor stopped: within 50 ms

title: Sleep-mode current consumption
procedure: Connect the controller to 12 V supply via a calibrated µA-capable ammeter, 23 °C. Put the controller into sleep mode and wait for the current to settle. Record the average current over 60 s.
pass_criteria: Sleep-mode supply current at 12 V: < 100 µA

title: Reverse battery withstand
procedure: Apply -14 V to the supply input, 23 °C, for 60 s. Restore normal polarity at 13.5 V. Run functional check of movement, CAN and diagnostics.
pass_criteria: Controller after -14 V for 60 s: without damage; Functional check after test: full function (no damage)

title: Manual mode movement and stop on release
procedure: 13.5 V, 23 °C, normalized, window mid-position. Hold switch for 1 s in close, then release; measure time from release to motor stop. Repeat in open direction. Hold switch for 2 s and confirm window moves throughout the hold. Repeat 10 times.
pass_criteria: Window movement while switch held: moves while the switch is held; Time from switch release to window stop: within 100 ms

title: Post-ignition-off movement window
procedure: Switch ignition off with doors closed; operate switch at 55 s and 59 s (just inside) – expect movement. Operate switch at 61 s (just outside) – expect no movement. Repeat: ignition off, open front door at 10 s via simulated door signal, then operate the switch. Repeat with a rear door opened only, switch at 30 s.
pass_criteria: Window movement after ignition off: allowed for 60 s or until a front door is opened, whichever comes first

title: Express start on short press
procedure: 13.5 V, 23 °C, normalized, mid-position. Press switch for 250 ms and 299 ms in the close direction, release, observe movement; repeat for open direction. Press for 301 ms and 400 ms and observe behavior (manual expected).
pass_criteria: Press shorter than 300 ms: starts express mode in the pressed direction

title: Stop on second press in express mode
procedure: Start express close, then press the switch in the close direction mid-travel; measure time to stop. Repeat with a second press in the open direction. Repeat for express open start with both second-press directions.
pass_criteria: Time from second press to window stop (either direction): within 100 ms

title: Full travel time
procedure: Set 13.5 V and 23 °C, normalized, nominal window load. Drive window from fully open (480 mm) to fully closed (0 mm) in express mode; time with CAN/position log. Repeat 5 times.
pass_criteria: Open-to-closed travel time at 13.5 V, 23 °C: 3.0 s to 4.5 s

title: Motor stop at end positions
procedure: Express close to 0 mm and express open to 480 mm. Monitor motor current/drive output after reaching each end position. Repeat in manual mode holding the switch beyond the end position.
pass_criteria: Motor drive at end position: motor stopped

title: CAN WLC_CloseAll
procedure: Normalized, window at 300 mm, 13.5 V. Send CAN WLC_CloseAll from simulated body controller; observe movement. Repeat and insert a pinch obstacle (>80 N) in the pinch zone during the close.
pass_criteria: Window response to WLC_CloseAll: closes in express mode; Anti-pinch during CloseAll: active

title: Express close only when normalized
procedure: Set controller to not normalized (interrupt supply >500 ms). Short-press close; observe. Normalize per WLC-022, then short-press close again.
pass_criteria: Express close when not normalized: not available; Express close when normalized: available

title: Pinch detection threshold
procedure: Normalized, 13.5 V, 23 °C, closing in the pinch zone. Using a force-calibrated obstacle, apply 70 N, 79 N (just below), 81 N (just above) and 100 N at positions 5 mm, 100 mm and 199 mm. Record whether a pinch is detected.
pass_criteria: Pinch detection while closing in the pinch zone: detected when pinch force exceeds 80 N

title: Pinch reaction: stop time and reversal distance
procedure: Trigger a pinch at 150 mm while closing; measure time from detection to motor stop and reversal distance. Trigger a pinch at 100 mm (reverse limited by fully open not applicable) and at 400 mm-equivalent test with window position near open such that remaining travel <150 mm (e.g. pinch at 4 mm region and an open-limit case via position simulation at 350 mm start). Record reversal distance in each case.
pass_criteria: Time from pinch detection to motor stop: within 10 ms; Reversal distance: at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less

title: Anti-pinch active in manual and express modes
procedure: Normalized, 13.5 V. Close in manual mode and apply 81 N obstacle in pinch zone. Close in express mode and apply 81 N obstacle in pinch zone.
pass_criteria: Anti-pinch in manual mode: active; Anti-pinch in express mode: active

title: Anti-pinch disabled when not normalized
procedure: Make controller not normalized (supply interruption >500 ms). Close in manual mode and apply 81 N obstacle in pinch zone; observe response. Normalize and repeat for comparison.
pass_criteria: Anti-pinch when not normalized: disabled

title: Express close inhibit after pinch reversal
procedure: Trigger a pinch reversal. Attempt express close (short press) at 1.9 s after reversal and at 2.1 s after reversal. Repeat the 1.0 s attempt.
pass_criteria: Express close after pinch reversal: inhibited for 2 s

title: Three pinches within 30 s: manual close only
procedure: Trigger three pinch detections within 25 s; then attempt express close and manual close. Attempt at 59 s and 61 s after the third pinch. Separate run: three pinches spread over 31 s and confirm lockout is not applied.
pass_criteria: Closing after three pinch detections within 30 s: allowed only in manual mode for the next 60 s

title: Position resolution
procedure: Feed simulated Hall pulses corresponding to known travel increments. Read position from WLC_Status over increments of 0.5 mm and calibrated total travel of 480 mm. Compare to reference.
pass_criteria: Position resolution: 0.5 mm or better

title: Normalization lost after supply interruption
procedure: Normalized controller at 13.5 V. Interrupt supply for 400 ms and 490 ms; read normalization state. Interrupt for 510 ms and 600 ms; read normalization state.
pass_criteria: Normalization state after interruption longer than 500 ms: not normalized

title: Normalization by holding closed
procedure: Start from not normalized. In manual mode hold window fully closed against seal for 0.9 s then release; check state. Repeat holding for 1.0 s and 1.1 s. Repeat in express mode attempt (not expected to normalize).
pass_criteria: Normalization after holding fully closed against seal in manual mode: normalizes after 1 s

title: Thermal model estimation
procedure: Review software design and thermal model documentation. Run a repeated-cycle HIL profile and compare estimated temperature signal to the model reference.
pass_criteria: Motor temperature estimate by thermal model: [TBD: limit needed]

title: Thermal current limit, block and release
procedure: Inject estimated motor temperature via model override at 129 °C, 131 °C: measure motor current during movement. Raise to 139 °C and 141 °C: attempt opening and closing. Decrease temperature to 121 °C and 119 °C: attempt opening.
pass_criteria: Motor current above 130 °C: limited to 15 A; Opening above 140 °C: blocked, closing only allowed; Thermal blocking below 120 °C: ends

title: WLC_Status cycle time and content
procedure: Log CAN for 60 s in idle, moving and fault conditions at 13.5 V. Compute min/max interval between WLC_Status frames. Check position, movement state, normalization and fault signals.
pass_criteria: WLC_Status cycle time: 50 ms ± 5 ms; Message content: window position, movement state, normalization state and fault state

title: Hall sensor loss fault B1A01
procedure: Drive the motor and remove Hall pulses for 150 ms, then 250 ms. Read DTCs and motor state.
pass_criteria: DTC B1A01 when Hall signal missing while motor driven: stored when missing for more than 200 ms; Motor on B1A01: stopped

title: Overcurrent fault B1A02, motor stop, status
procedure: Inject motor current of 24 A for 100 ms, 26 A for 40 ms (below time), and 26 A for 60 ms. Read DTCs, motor state and WLC_Status fault state.
pass_criteria: DTC B1A02: stored when motor current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms; Motor with B1A02 stored: stopped; Fault state in WLC_Status with B1A02 stored: set

title: Diagnostic response time
procedure: Send 100 diagnostic requests at idle and during window movement. Measure request-to-response time.
pass_criteria: Diagnostic response time: within 50 ms

title: Operating temperature range
procedure: Soak controller at -40 °C, 23 °C and 85 °C for 2 h each, at 13.5 V. At each temperature, run manual/express movement, anti-pinch and CAN checks. Check at -39 °C and 84 °C as boundary.
pass_criteria: Operation at ambient from -40 °C to 85 °C: operates from -40 °C to 85 °C

title: Wake-up time from sleep
procedure: Put controller into sleep at 13.5 V. Press switch; measure time from press to wake (CAN activity/motor drive). Repeat 10 times, also at -40 °C and 85 °C.
pass_criteria: Wake time from switch press: within 100 ms
